note: Site Audit runs best-practice checks grouped into 13 reports (checklist plugin type site_audit_checklist) made of checks (site_audit_check). Run via Drush: site_audit:audit (alias audit), site_audit:all (audit-all, aa), site_audit:list (audit-list), with --format=text|html|json|markdown, --detail, --bootstrap, --skip. Admin page site_audit.report at /admin/reports/site-audit (perm administer site configuration); settings form (SiteAuditConfigForm) writes site_audit.settings key 'reports' (checkboxes; empty => run all). Custom checks/reports extend SiteAuditCheckBase/SiteAuditChecklistBase with @SiteAuditCheck (property 'checklist') / @SiteAuditChecklist annotations. Medium cases read the live site_audit.settings 'reports' config; hard cases write that config or generate a Drush HTML report, verified against live state. site_audit.settings does not exist by default (baseline = all reports run).

evals.prompt: The site_audit module is installed on my Drupal 11 site. What Drush command runs the full best-practice audit, and how do I run just one report (e.g. cache)?
evals.expected_output: Run all reports with `drush site_audit:audit` / `drush audit` (or `drush audit-all` / `aa`). Run a single report by naming it, e.g. `drush audit cache`. `drush audit-list` lists every report and check.

evals.prompt: How do I get a site_audit report as HTML (or another format) instead of plain console text, and how do I write it to a file?
evals.expected_output: Use the --format option: text (default), html, json, or markdown, e.g. `drush audit --format=html > report.html`. --bootstrap wraps HTML in Bootstrap styles (and forces html); --detail shows details for passing checks.

evals.prompt: How do I add a custom check to site_audit and attach it to an existing report? Which base class and annotation do I use, and how do I say which report it belongs to?
evals.expected_output: Create a plugin in your module's src/Plugin/SiteAuditCheck/ extending SiteAuditCheckBase with a @SiteAuditCheck annotation (id, name, description) whose `checklist` property is the id of the report to attach to (e.g. checklist = "cache"). Implement calculateScore() (PASS=2/WARN=1/FAIL=0/INFO=3) and the getResult*() messages. A custom report extends SiteAuditChecklistBase with @SiteAuditChecklist.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, the site_audit admin audit page has been configured to run only a subset of its reports. Inspect the live site_audit configuration and name the reports that are selected to run.
evals.expected_output: site_audit.settings 'reports' has cache and security enabled (their values equal their ids); all other reports are unselected.

evals.prompt: This site has the site_audit report selection configured to a single report in its settings config. Inspect the live configuration and state which report is selected.

On this Drupal site, configure the site_audit module so that the admin audit page (/admin/reports/site-audit) runs only the Cache and Status reports, and nothing else. Apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: Set site_audit.settings 'reports' so only the cache and status checklists are enabled (e.g. reports: {cache: cache, status: status}) via the Settings form or config. Verify checks that the enabled (truthy) report ids are exactly [cache, status].

evals.prompt: Using the site_audit Drush command, generate an HTML report of ONLY the Cache report for this site and save it to the file /tmp/site_audit_eval_report.html on the server. Run it against the live site.
evals.expected_output: Run `drush audit cache --format=html > /tmp/site_audit_eval_report.html` (from the Drupal root inside the container). Verify checks the file exists and contains a Site Audit HTML report mentioning Cache.
